queries.description: One row per interactive operation. The raw table holds one row per operation per sampled timepoint (plus a "Power BI Service" companion row for some queries), so the source query keeps one row per operation_id, preferring the named user. Rejected operations arrive with no operation_id and are all kept.

queries.name: factBackgroundOps
queries.description: One row per background operation per item. The raw table repeats every operation once per sampled timepoint for the 24 hours it is smoothed over, and one operation_id can cover several items (SQL endpoint and dataflow queries), so the source query groups to operation + item grain instead of deduplicating on operation_id alone.

queries.name: factCapacityLoad
queries.description: Capacity load at each sampled 30-second checkpoint (one per hour today). Built from the RAW timepoint rows before any deduplication: at a sampled checkpoint the Metrics app lists every operation contributing to it, so the sum of timepoint_cu_s is the exact smoothed load at that moment, which is what the Metrics app plots as utilization. Interactive rows are kept only at checkpoints where background was also captured, so the two always add up at the same instants even if interactive is sampled more often.
text: SELECT UPPER(capacity_id) AS capacity_id, sampled_timepoint, SUM(timepoint_cu_s) AS timepoint_cu_s
SELECT UPPER(capacity_id) AS capacity_id, sampled_timepoint, SUM(timepoint_cu_s) AS timepoint_cu_s
SELECT capacity_id, sampled_timepoint, 'Background' AS workload_type, timepoint_cu_s FROM b
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT capacity_id, sampled_timepoint FROM b) bt
ON bt.capacity_id = i.capacity_id AND bt.sampled_timepoint = i.sampled_timepoint",
AddDate = Table.AddColumn(Types, "sampled_date", each DateTime.Date([sampled_timepoint]), type date),

queries.name: dimCapacity
queries.description: Every capacity seen in the capacity data, with a display name and its size in CU. Names and sizes come from the VALUES list in the query until the ingestion notebook persists the admin capacities API (which carries the SKU). capacity_cu drives every utilization % measure; blank = utilization not shown for that capacity.

SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(capacity_id) AS capacity_id FROM dbo.factCapacityMetricsInteractive
LEFT JOIN known ON known.capacity_id = ids.capacity_id

queries.name: dimWorkspace
queries.description: Every workspace seen in the capacity data. Name and state come from the tenant inventory when it knows the workspace, falling back to the latest name the Metrics app reported. Both lakehouses sit behind the same SQL endpoint, so the tenant table is read with a cross-database name.
text: SELECT workspace_id, sampled_timepoint, workspace_name FROM dbo.factCapacityMetricsInteractive
SELECT workspace_id, sampled_timepoint, workspace_name FROM dbo.factCapacityMetricsBackground
WHERE workspace_id IS NOT NULL AND workspace_id <> ''
SELECT UPPER(id) AS workspace_id, name, state, type, IsDeleted,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UPPER(id) ORDER BY name) AS rn
WHERE IsCurrent = 1 AND id IS NOT NULL AND id <> ''
LEFT JOIN t ON t.workspace_id = m.workspace_id AND t.rn = 1",
queries.lastLoadedAsTableFormulaText:
{"IncludesReferencedQueries":false,"RootFormulaText":"let
    Sql = "
        WITH m AS (
            SELECT UPPER(workspace_id) AS workspace_id,
                   MAX(CONCAT(CONVERT(char(23), sampled_timepoint, 121), workspace_name)) AS name_packed
            FROM (
                SELECT workspace_id, sampled_timepoint, workspace_name FROM dbo.factCapacityMetricsInteractive
                UNION ALL
                SELECT workspace_id, sampled_timepoint, workspace_name FROM dbo.factCapacityMetricsBackground
            ) f
            WHERE workspace_id IS NOT NULL AND workspace_id <> ''
            GROUP BY UPPER(workspace_id)
        ),
        t AS (
            SELECT UPPER(id) AS workspace_id, name, state, type, IsDeleted,
                   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UPPER(id) ORDER BY name) AS rn
            FROM [" & TenantDB & "].dbo.dimWorkspaces
            WHERE IsCurrent = 1 AND id IS NOT NULL AND id <> ''
        )
        SELECT m.workspace_id,
               COALESCE(NULLIF(t.name, ''), NULLIF(SUBSTRING(m.name_packed, 24, 4000), ''), '(unknown workspace)') AS workspace_name,
               t.state, t.type, t.IsDeleted
        FROM m
        LEFT JOIN t ON t.workspace_id = m.workspace_id AND t.rn = 1",

queries.name: dimItem
queries.description: Every item seen in the capacity data, keyed on item + workspace. Name and kind are the most recently reported values across both workloads. IDs are upper-cased to match the fact tables.
text: SELECT UPPER(item_id) AS item_id, UPPER(workspace_id) AS workspace_id,
MAX(CASE WHEN item_name > '' THEN CONCAT(CONVERT(char(23), sampled_timepoint, 121), item_name) END) AS name_packed,
MAX(CASE WHEN item_kind > '' THEN CONCAT(CONVERT(char(23), sampled_timepoint, 121), item_kind) END) AS kind_packed
SELECT UPPER(item_id) AS item_id, UPPER(workspace_id) AS workspace_id,
MAX(CASE WHEN item_name > '' THEN CONCAT(CONVERT(char(23), sampled_timepoint, 121), item_name) END) AS name_packed,
MAX(CASE WHEN item_kind > '' THEN CONCAT(CONVERT(char(23), sampled_timepoint, 121), item_kind) END) AS kind_packed
CASE WHEN i.name_packed > b.name_packed OR b.name_packed IS NULL THEN i.name_packed ELSE b.name_packed END AS name_packed,
CASE WHEN i.kind_packed > b.kind_packed OR b.kind_packed IS NULL THEN i.kind_packed ELSE b.kind_packed END AS kind_packed
FULL OUTER JOIN i ON i.item_id = b.item_id AND i.workspace_id = b.workspace_id
queries.lastLoadedAsTableFormulaText:
{"IncludesReferencedQueries":false,"RootFormulaText":"let
    Sql = "
        WITH b AS (
            SELECT UPPER(item_id) AS item_id, UPPER(workspace_id) AS workspace_id,
                   MAX(sampled_timepoint) AS last_seen,
                   MAX(CASE WHEN item_name > '' THEN CONCAT(CONVERT(char(23), sampled_timepoint, 121), item_name) END) AS name_packed,
                   MAX(CASE WHEN item_kind > '' THEN CONCAT(CONVERT(char(23), sampled_timepoint, 121), item_kind) END) AS kind_packed
            FROM dbo.factCapacityMetricsBackground
            GROUP BY UPPER(item_id), UPPER(workspace_id)
        ),
        i AS (
            SELECT UPPER(item_id) AS item_id, UPPER(workspace_id) AS workspace_id,
                   MAX(sampled_timepoint) AS last_seen,
                   MAX(CASE WHEN item_name > '' THEN CONCAT(CONVERT(char(23), sampled_timepoint, 121), item_name) END) AS name_packed,
                   MAX(CASE WHEN item_kind > '' THEN CONCAT(CONVERT(char(23), sampled_timepoint, 121), item_kind) END) AS kind_packed
            FROM dbo.factCapacityMetricsInteractive
            GROUP BY UPPER(item_id), UPPER(workspace_id)
        ),
        j AS (
            SELECT COALESCE(b.item_id, i.item_id) AS item_id,
                   COALESCE(b.workspace_id, i.workspace_id) AS workspace_id,
                   b.last_seen AS last_seen_background,
                   SUBSTRING(b.name_packed, 24, 4000) AS item_name_background,
                   SUBSTRING(b.kind_packed, 24, 4000) AS item_kind_background,
                   SUBSTRING(i.name_packed, 24, 4000) AS item_name_interactive,
                   SUBSTRING(i.kind_packed, 24, 4000) AS item_kind_interactive,
                   i.last_seen AS last_seen_interactive,
                   CASE WHEN i.name_packed > b.name_packed OR b.name_packed IS NULL THEN i.name_packed ELSE b.name_packed END AS name_packed,
                   CASE WHEN i.kind_packed > b.kind_packed OR b.kind_packed IS NULL THEN i.kind_packed ELSE b.kind_packed END AS kind_packed
            FROM b
            FULL OUTER JOIN i ON i.item_id = b.item_id AND i.workspace_id = b.workspace_id
        )
        SELECT item_id, workspace_id,
               CONCAT(item_id, '||', workspace_id) AS item_key,
               COALESCE(SUBSTRING(name_packed, 24, 4000), item_id, '(unknown item)') AS item_name,
               COALESCE(SUBSTRING(kind_packed, 24, 4000), '(unknown)') AS item_kind,
               item_name_background, item_kind_background, item_name_interactive, item_kind_interactive,
               last_seen_background, last_seen_interactive
        FROM j",

        {"item_id", type text},

        {"item_name_interactive", type text},
